structured_output.summary: The embedded audit verified the implementation of TP-DMX-MCP-DOCTOR-FORMULA-RESERVED-001. The reserved port severity rules correctly distinguish between pure-formula and configured ports. The DOPECON_BRIDGE_TOKEN interpolation placeholder is properly used and safely excluded from mcp.env. Foreign compose.yml parsing hazards are successfully bypassed when explicitly setting the repo path. Explicit compose boot for task-orchestrator correctly fails closed without a true token. The unit tests provide full coverage for these intent criteria. No secrets, scope creep, or out-of-scope changes were identified.
